subject: Skyline Labs — vendor master setup & PO contact
thread_summary: Vendor provided W9, bank proof and completed onboarding form. Internal team clarified legal name & tax ID mismatch; vendor master created and vendor ID provided. Next: first PO flow and invoice routing confirmed.
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maya Kapoor <maya@skylinelabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Skyline Labs — vendor master setup & PO contact

Hi Maya,

Welcome — glad to get Skyline Labs into our vendor roster. To set up your vendor master record and route purchase orders (POs) and invoices correctly, could you please send the following items: 

- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached template here if easier; you can also fill and return).
- W-9 (or relevant tax form for your entity).
- A bank account confirmation (letter from bank, voided check, or screenshot of account details).
- Primary remit address and the preferred invoice email for AP.
- Name and email of the person who should receive formal POs (PO contact).

If Skyline uses a DBA, please include the legal entity name and the DBA so we can record both. Our procurement and AP teams need the exact legal name that matches your tax documents to avoid payment delays.

I’ve cc’d Marissa (AP) and Dylan (Sourcing) so they’re looped in. If you prefer, you can upload documents to the Drive link below or send them to accounts@redwood.com.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_vendor_docs

Thanks — if you can get these back to us by EOD Tuesday, we’ll aim to have your vendor number and PO routing set up within 48 hours of receipt.

Best,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
(k) +1 415-555-0132

Thanks — attaching the files you requested. Quick notes:

- Attached: Skyline_vendor_form.xlsx (filled), Skyline_W9.pdf, Skyline_BankAcct_Proof.png.
- Legal name on tax docs: Skyline Laboratories, Inc. We trade as "Skyline Labs" publicly — hope that is okay to include as a DBA.
- PO contact: Jordan Ellis (j.ellis@skylinelabs.com), title: Head of Strategic Partnerships.
- Invoice routing: please send invoices to accounts@skylinelabs.com; we prefer invoices in PDF with the PO number included.

One question: your onboarding form asks for a remit address vs. legal address. Our legal address is 1288 Harbor Ave, Suite 400, San Mateo, CA 94402. Remit address is the same for domestic payments.

Subject: Re: Skyline Labs — vendor master setup & PO contact

Hi Maya — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the documents. I pulled the attachments into our onboarding folder and reviewed them. A couple of clarifying points before I create the vendor master: 

1) Legal name confirmation: Your W-9 lists "Skyline Laboratories, Inc." and the vendor form shows "Skyline Labs" as the company name. To avoid mismatches in our ERP, confirm that the legal name we should record is "Skyline Laboratories, Inc." and that "Skyline Labs" should be saved as a DBA/alternate name.

2) Tax ID: the W-9 appears to have the EIN partially obscured in the scanned copy. Can you either resend a clearer copy or confirm the last four digits of the EIN for verification? We only need the last 4 to match to IRS lookup for our records.

3) Bank proof: the image is acceptable but can you confirm the account holder name exactly as it appears on the bank records (so we can match to legal entity)?

Once we have those three confirmations, I will:
- Create the vendor master record (vendor id will follow),
- Add Jordan Ellis as the PO contact, and
- Add accounts@skylinelabs.com as the invoice routing email.

If you prefer to e-sign a vendor agreement or use DocuSign for recordkeeping, I can send a DocuSign link — would you like that?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Accounts Payable Manager | Redwood Inference

- PO contact: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@skylinelabs.com> (added)

Best regards,
